description.text: The third expansion of the MEGA series, released on 23 January 2026. Mega Zygarde ex, the key Pokémon of Pokémon Legends: Z-A, leads it: a Basic Pokémon whose attack Nihil Zero flips a coin for each of the opponent's Pokémon and does 150 damage to each one that comes up heads, and which can use the attack Geo Buster for 350 damage with the Pokémon Tool Core Memory attached. Mega Starmie ex, also a newly discovered Mega Evolution, joins it, with Decidueye ex, Meowth ex, whose Ability takes a Supporter from the deck when it is played from the hand onto the Bench, Mega Clefable ex, Mega Skarmory ex, Salazzle ex and Yveltal ex. Lumiose City appears as a Stadium that lets each player, once during their turn, put a Basic Pokémon from the deck onto the Bench and end their turn, and in the backgrounds of other cards, with the Supporters Tarragon and Naveen. Special Energy that strengthens one type, known from the XY and Sword & Shield series, came back with Rocky Fighting Energy, Growing Grass Energy and Telepathic Psychic Energy, and Poké Pad was reprinted. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 80, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Trainer cards, Special Art Rare cards, and Mega Zygarde ex as a Mega Ultra Rare. From its release, cards with the G regulation mark left the Standard format. In English most of its cards came out in Perfect Order in March 2026.
